package.description: Quick fixes and software inventory for IT technicians.

en-US.description: Quick fixes and software inventory for IT technicians.
en-US.longDescription: QixFix is a cross-platform technician utility combining a Quick Fix Toolbox (DNS flush, network reset, print service restart, cache clear, font cache rebuild) with a Software Snapshot tool for listing and exporting installed software. Runs the same way on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en-US.name: QixFix
